stepTitle: A glucose solution being administered with an IV has a flow rate of $$4.00\,\text{cm}**3/\text{min}.$$ What will the new flow rate be if the glucose is replaced by whole blood having the same density but a viscosity $$2.50$$ times that of the glucose? All other factors remain constant (in $$\text{cm}**3/\text{min})$$.
